_comment: The callout kinds a note may be written with, in the one place both
processes read them from. src/callouts.js imports this and draws from it;
electron/ai.js requires it and names the ids in the copilot's briefing.
Whole entries rather than ids alone: splitting the names from the tone and
icon would leave two lists to keep in step, which is the drift this file
exists to prevent. The tone names a palette custom property and the icon
names an entry in the renderer's icon set — both are read only by
src/callouts.js, and both are here so that adding a kind is one edit.
The ids and aliases are Obsidian's, which is the dialect people's existing
